description: This file provides Russian localization messages for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translations for various user interface messages used by Select2.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when content fails to load.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Provides the message when user input exceeds the maximum allowed length, including pluralization logic.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Provides the message when user input is shorter than the minimum required length, including pluralization logic.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while more data is being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Provides the message when the maximum number of selections is reached, including pluralization logic.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
